assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production VFX ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET with SIX DIFFERENT SEQUENTIAL HAND-DRAWN POSES. Wide 3:2 canvas, exact regular grid of THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, six equal SQUARE cells. Read frame order left to right top row then bottom row. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background throughout all empty space. No background color, no ground plane, no labels, no numbers, no dividers, no text. Each drawing strictly inside its own cell, 12% empty margin on every side. Consistent anchor: action center at cell horizontal center and 72% down the cell; ground effects share a baseline at 82% down. Keep the same world scale between frames: later fragments get smaller, DO NOT zoom each frame to fill the cell. This is a real animation breakdown with evolving shapes, not six identical icons. Style: polished French tactical RPG traditional CEL ANIMATION, broad opaque flat color masses, limited four-tone shading, crisp tapered navy outline, clean ivory leading edges, strong silhouette and negative space. NO 3D render, NO painterly grain, NO bloom, NO blurry transparency, NO excessive tiny particles. Sprite will be displayed roughly 160 pixels wide. A single sweeping steel-white blade crescent with a dark navy edge and cool cyan underside, travelling diagonally up-right. Frame 1 a sharp narrow contact streak, 2 a broad beautifully curved slash, 3 the arc opens wide, 4 tip separates into two curved slivers, 5 slender travelling fragments, 6 three tiny fading chips. No weapon handle, no rings.
